5.82.e: For Savitar who is Bhaga shall send riches to his worshipper.  That wondrous portion we implore.

5.82.d: अद्या नो देव सवितः परजावत सावीः सौभगम | परा दुष्वप्न्यं सुव ||
5.82.e: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny.  Drive thou the evil dream away.

5.82.d: विश्वानि देव सवितर दुरितानि परा सुव | यद भद्रं तन न आ सुव ||
5.82.e: Savitar, God, send far away all sorrows and calamities,  And send us only what is good.

5.82.d: अनागसो अदितये देवस्य सवितुः सवे | विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ||
5.82.e: Sinless in sight of Aditi through the God Savitar's influence,  May we obtain all lovely things.

5.82.d: आ विश्वदेवं सत्पतिं सूक्तैर अद्या वर्णीमहे | सत्यसवं सवितारम ||
5.82.e: We with our hymns this day elect the general God, Lord of the good,  Savitar whose decrees are true.

5.82.d: य इमे उभे अहनी पुर एत्य अप्रयुछन | सवाधीर देवः सविता ||
5.82.e: He who for ever vigilant precedes these Twain, the Day and Night,  Is Savitar the thoughtful God.

5.82.d: य इमा विश्वा जातान्य आश्रावयति शलोकेन | पर च सुवाति सविता ||
5.82.e: He who gives glory unto all these living creatures with the song,  And brings them forth, is Savitar.

5.83.d: अछा वद तवसं गीर्भिर आभि सतुहि पर्जन्यं नमसा विवास | कनिक्रदद वर्षभो जीरदानू रेतो दधात्य ओषधीषु गर्भम ||
5.83.e: SING with these songs thy welcome to the Mighty, with adoration praise and call Parjanya.  The Bull, loud roaring, swift to send his bounty, lays in the plants the seed. for germination.

5.83.d: वि वर्क्षान हन्त्य उत हन्ति रक्षसो विश्वम बिभाय भुवनम महावधात | उतानागा ईषते वर्ष्ण्यावतो यत पर्जन्य सतनयन हन्ति दुष्क्र्तः ||
5.83.e: He smites the trees apart, he slays the demons: all life fears him who wields the mighty weapon.  From him exceeding strong fices e’en the guiltless, when thundering Parjanya smites the wicked.

5.83.d: रथीव कशयाश्वां अभिक्षिपन्न आविर दूतान कर्णुते वर्ष्य्रं अह | दूरात सिंहस्य सतनथा उद ईरते यत पर्जन्यः कर्णुते वर्ष्यं नभः ||
5.83.e: Like a car-driver whipping on his horses, he makes the messengers of rain spring forward.  Far off resounds the roaring of the lion, what time Parjanya fills the sky with rain-cloud.

5.83.d: पर वाता वान्ति पतयन्ति विद्युत उद ओषधीर जिहते पिन्वते सवः | इरा विश्वस्मै भुवनाय जायते यत पर्जन्यः पर्थिवीं रेतसावति ||
5.83.e: Forth burst the winds, down come the lightning-flashes: the plants shoot up, the realm of light is streaming.  Food springs abundant for all living creatures, what time Parjanya quickens earth with moisture.

5.83.d: यस्य वरते पर्थिवी नन्नमीति यस्य वरते शफवज जर्भुरीति | यस्य वरत ओषधीर विश्वरूपाः स नः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यछ ||
5.83.e: Thou at whose bidding earth bows low before thee, at whose command hoofed cattle fly in terror,  At whose behest the plants assume all colours, even thou Parjanya, yield us great protection.

5.83.d: दिवो नो वर्ष्टिम मरुतो ररीध्वम पर पिन्वत वर्ष्णो अश्वस्य धाराः | अर्वाङ एतेन सतनयित्नुनेह्य अपो निषिञ्चन्न असुरः पिता नः ||
5.83.e: Send down for us the rain of heaven, ye Maruts, and let the Stallion's flood descend in torrents.  Come hither with this thunder while thou pourest the waters down, our heavenly Lord and Father.

5.83.d: अभि करन्द सतनय गर्भम आ धा उदन्वता परि दीया रथेन | दर्तिं सु कर्ष विषितं नयञ्चं समा भवन्तूद्वतो निपादाः ||
5.83.e: Thunder and roar: the germ of life deposit. Fly round us on thy chariot waterladen.  Thine opened water-skin draw with thee downward, and let the hollows and the heights be level.

5.83.d: महान्तं कोशम उद अचा नि षिञ्च सयन्दन्तां कुल्या विषिताः पुरस्तात | घर्तेन दयावाप्र्थिवी वय उन्धि सुप्रपाणम भवत्व अघ्न्याभ्यः ||
5.83.e: Lift up the mighty vessel, pour down water, and let the liberated streams rush forward.  Saturate both the earth and heaven with fatness, and for the cows let there be drink abundant.

5.83.d: यत पर्जन्य कनिक्रदत सतनयन हंसि दुष्क्र्तः | परतीदं विश्वम मोदते यत किं च पर्थिव्याम अधि ||
5.83.e: When thou, with thunder and with roar, Parjanya, smitest sinners down,  This universe exults thereat, yea, all that is upon the earth.

5.83.d: अवर्षीर वर्षम उद उ षू गर्भायाकर धन्वान्य अत्येतवा उ | अजीजन ओषधीर भोजनाय कम उत परजाभ्यो ऽविदो मनीषाम ||
5.83.e: Thou hast poured down the rain-flood now withhold it. Thou hast made desert places fit for travel.  Thou hast made herbs to grow for our enjoyment: yea, thou hast won thee praise from living creatures.

5.84.d: बळ इत्था पर्वतानां खिद्रम बिभर्षि पर्थिवि | पर या भूमिम परवत्वति मह्ना जिनोषि महिनि ||
5.84.e: THOU, of a truth,O Prthivi, bearest the tool that rends the hills:  Thou rich in torrents, who with might quickenest earth, O Mighty One.

5.84.d: सतोमासस तवा विचारिणि परति षटोभन्त्य अक्तुभिः | पर या वाजं न हेषन्तम पेरुम अस्यस्य अर्जुनि ||
5.84.e: To thee, O wanderer at will, ring out the lauds with beams of day,  Who drivest, like a neighing steed, the swelling cloud, O bright of hue.

5.84.d: दर्ळ्हा चिद या वनस्पतीन कष्मया दर्धर्ष्य ओजसा | यत ते अभ्रस्य विद्युतो दिवो वर्षन्ति वर्ष्टयः ||
5.84.e: Who graspest with thy might on earth. e’en the strong sovrans of the wood,  When from the lightning of thy cloud the rain-floods of the heaven descend.
